explanation: - Vertical: Upgrading CPU/RAM on the single server. - Read-Replicas: Offloading read queries (SELECT) to replica nodes while writes (INSERT/UPDATE) go to the primary node. - Sharding: Partitioning rows across multiple database instances based on a shard key (e.g. tenantid or userid).
